link.note: Tree shows him as father of Mary, wife of William Wells. Both standard genealogies reject this (Hayes 1878; Youngs 1907); his daughter Mary (b. 1631) married Edward Petty. Mary Mapes's 1678 will shows the Youngs link came via her son-in-law John Youngs. Unproven/probably wrong; not an ancestor.

summary: Founding minister of Southold; probably not John's ancestor (Youngs descent unproven).
bio: Southold's founding minister (William Wells was its leading founder after him). Wives per Youngs (1907): Joan Herrington, Joan (Harris) Palgrave, Mary (Warren) Gardner. Children: John, Thomas, Mary (m. Edward Petty), Rachel, Joseph, Benjamin, Christopher. His sister married William Browne of Salem. Not in the Rootsweb Youngs index as father of a Mary Wells. Col. John Youngs and the Oyster Bay Youngses are therefore not proven kin.
